13: So which of your Lord’s bountieswill you both deny?That is, the jinn and humans. The pronoun ‘you’ and the adjective ‘your’ are both dual in the Arabic.

17: Lord of the two easts,and Lord of the two wests!That is, the points of sunrise and sunset at the winter and summer solstices.
